# Mind Module

> Mind Module is a proactive mental performance OS that helps executives sustain focus, energy, and recovery under load.

Mind Module blends physiological signals (HRV, sleep, recovery), calendar load, and self-check-ins into a daily readiness brief, an adaptive mastery plan, and an on-demand executive coach.

- [Home](/): Overview of the mental performance OS for leaders.
